title: Finite local constant cohomology is closed under distinguished triangles

from.place: proof step 1: use the Serre class with the reduction coefficient convention

statement: Let T be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and B a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Use the constant coefficient ring formed in commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension] and its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and cohomology [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. If both outer terms of a distinguished triangle have local constant finite B-module descriptions [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules] in every cohomological degree, so does the middle term. No cohomological boundedness is required.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-local-models-comparison] to obtain the unit-compatible constant-ring isomorphism and agreement of local models under scalar restriction. That restriction is an exact equivalence of abelian categories, with sectionwise cancellation isomorphisms.

The kernel, cokernel and extension conclusions of [lem-weil-pbc-locally-constant-derived-serre], together with transport of covering trivializations along isomorphisms, make finite local constant modules over the old constant ring a weak Serre class. Kernel and cokernel universality transfer closure from the chosen kernel and cokernel objects to arbitrary limiting forks and coforks.

The homology-property closure underlying [lem-sbc-cohomology-in-weak-serre-subcategory] applies to the image triangle under the exact derived coefficient equivalence. Exact functors commute with homology, so the local-model comparison transfers the two outer hypotheses to this triangle. Its middle conclusion transfers back by the inverse homology comparison and the local-model equivalence. The proof only needs middle-term closure, so it uses the existing IsTriangulatedClosed2 instance and does not need a separate contains-zero argument.

    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]

      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj t.obj₃)) :
